command: npx tsx scripts/eval-bench.ts --split all --embeddings hash --out bench/results/hash.json

corpus.splitRule: Every fifth case per category is held out (index % 5 === 4); tuning must use train only.

engines.name: bm25_only
engines.description: Weighted FTS5 BM25, no vector stream, no graph stream, no ranking boosts.

engines.name: bm25_hash
engines.description: BM25 plus the offline feature-hash vector stream, no graph stream or boosts.

engines.name: bm25_graph
engines.description: BM25 plus file/entity graph activation, no vector stream or boosts.

engines.name: full_hash
engines.description: BM25 + hash vectors + graph + conditional trap/verified boosts, candidate graph seeding off.

engines.name: no_graph
engines.description: BM25 + hash vectors + boosts, graph stream disabled.

engines.name: no_trap
engines.description: BM25 + hash vectors + graph, trap boost disabled.

engines.name: static_dump
engines.description: All active memories in creation order; the full dump is counted in tokens.

notMeasured.name: bm25_minilm
notMeasured.reason: Not measured in this run. Use --embeddings minilm to load the local MiniLM model and measure it.
